metadata.question: Was the NVDI lower in northern Kenya than in southern Kenya during May-June 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking if NDVI was lower in northern Kenya than southern Kenya during May-June 2019. Strategy: 1. Define two regions: northern Kenya and southern Kenya using polygons 2. Use MODIS NDVI data (MOD13Q1) which provides 16-day NDVI composites at 250m resolution 3. Filter for May-June 2019 period 4. Calculate mean NDVI for each region 5. Compare the values to determine if northern Kenya had lower NDVI Data considerations: - MODIS NDVI is reliable for large-scale comparisons - Need to handle potential cloud cover and data gaps - Should validate that we have sufficient valid pixels in both regions Let me structure the code: 1. Define geometries for northern and southern Kenya 2. Get MODIS NDVI collection for the time period 3. Check if collection is empty (C1) 4. Calculate mean NDVI for each region 5. Check if we have valid pixels (C2) 6. Validate the results (C3) 7. Compare and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions for northern and southern Kenya const northKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[36.0, 4.0], [41.0, 4.0], [41.0, 5.0], [36.0, 5.0], [36.0, 4.0]] ]); const southKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[36.0, -4.0], [41.0, -4.0], [41.0, -1.0], [36.0, -1.0], [36.0, -4.0]] ]); // Get MODIS NDVI data for May-June 2019 const ndviCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterDate('2019-05-01', '2019-07-01') .select('NDVI'); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = ndviCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS NDVI images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI composite const meanNdvi = ndviCollection.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Apply scale factor // Calculate mean NDVI for each region const northStats = meanNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const southStats = meanNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to validate data const northCount = meanNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const southCount = meanNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const northNdvi = northStats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const southNdvi = southStats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`North Kenya - NDVI: ${northNdvi?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${northCount}`); console.log(`South Kenya - NDVI: ${southNdvi?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${southCount}`); // Check for valid pixels if (northCount === 0 || southCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate results if (northNdvi === null || southNdvi === null || isNaN(northNdvi) || isNaN(southNdvi) || northNdvi < -1 || northNdvi > 1 || southNdvi < -1 || southNdvi > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values if (northNdvi < southNdvi) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
